note: Forbidden: an address-updating message sent without NO_NATS_ALLOWED when NAT is prohibited. Ze sends two kinds, the first IKE_AUTH and the INFORMATIONAL carrying UPDATE_SA_ADDRESSES and NO_ADDITIONAL_ADDRESSES. It never sends ADDITIONAL_IP4/IP6 (startMobikeRequest, mobike.go). First IKE_AUTH: mbAuthHandshake under policy prohibit (from internal/component/ike/engine/mobike_test.go::TestMobikeConfiguredNATPolicy) requires NO_NATS_ALLOWED with the actual tuple, and internal/component/ike/engine/mobike_test.go::TestMobikeAuthRetransmitKeepsProtectedTuple covers the retransmission. The INFORMATIONAL update is covered by TestMobikeConfiguredNATPolicy (notification == nil goes red) and by internal/component/ike/engine/mobike_test.go::TestMobikeAdvertisementAfterSourceChange (Linux only) for original and replacement updates. Negative: allow and default policies send none.
